reason: Delegated independent review: the human instructed the agent to perform review gates itself (DECISION-c6b1521b), so no human read this diff. Known limitation deliberately not fixed here: core-types and config each define Chunk and SourceDocument - recorded KNOWLEDGE-491e06aa, unfixable inside T-04 scope. Interchange is demonstrated only against in-test fakes because no real component implements these protocols until T-06 through T-09g.
